title: Audit Before You Distill: code, data, and analysis for controlled reasoning transfer into compact medical language models
description: Code, released research materials, and analysis for a controlled study of reasoning distillation from a Qwen3-32B teacher into a Qwen3-4B student using Portuguese four- and five-option questions from Brazilian multiprofessional health residency examinations. Cross-question derangement separates question-relevant rationale content from length and format, while a paired ten-split design evaluates answer-only supervised fine-tuning, single-target distill-SFT, and multi-task step-by-step distillation.
notes: The dataset covers the 2024 and 2025 examination years, which is the complete study population; earlier years exist in the authors' internal item bank but were not used in any reported experiment. All 4,260 evaluations are retained and grouped into 3,792 normalised-stem clusters where clustered resampling is required. Canonical seeds, the documented 85/15 design, code, and aggregate result tables support comparable reruns and numerical auditing. Known implementation deviations are documented in the repository README. Licensing is file-specific: code and teacher-generated rationales use MIT, while examination items remain the property of the examining bodies named in data/README.md and are redistributed only for non-commercial research and educational use with attribution. The record-level Other (Non-Commercial) designation is conservative and does not relicense third-party examination content.
